integrity: Originality and value assessed against the full prime-product minimization claim; the previously known least-smallest-prime three-cycle and its explicit witness are not claimed as novel. The exact finite certificate is deterministic and depends on a proven exhaustive cutoff. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact least value is proved only among squarefree integers with exactly three distinct prime factors. It does not classify greater products, establish infinitude, or determine the unrestricted smallest nontrivial integer.
title: The least three-prime squarefree integer with an integral reciprocal-gcd sum
